en.askTitle: Put your own offers, savings and target role into the boxes and get the same MBA cost-and-funding comparison
en.runTitle: Lagos: a credit analyst weighs a UK, Canadian or online MBA for autumn 2027

fields.label: MBA offers and intake
fields.value: A one-year UK MBA, a two-year Canadian MBA and an online MBA kept alongside the job, all for autumn 2027

fields.label: Degree result, management experience and English evidence
fields.value: 30-year-old financial analyst in Lagos with 6 years of bank credit analysis, earning about NGN 14 million a year

fields.label: Target role and country
fields.placeholder: e.g. a corporate finance manager in Canada, or a senior credit role in Lagos

fields.label: Savings currency, protected reserve and monthly surplus
Written awards or employer support
fields.placeholder: e.g. a 30% scholarship offer in writing, or an employer paying part of the fees

en.template: Compare {offers} for my {evidence}, {role}, {savings} and {awards}. Show the whole funding gap, live-study workload and admissions or work-permit conditions still to confirm. Ask before contacting schools, applying or sharing documents.

phases.title: Research school costs, admissions, scholarships and outcomes from official pages
phases.note: UK, Canadian and online programmes side by side, plus the Nigerian central-bank exchange rate
phases.judgment: It said plainly where evidence was missing: no verified official salary or employment report for the two UK MBAs, and Birmingham’s own living-cost guide has an addition error that is flagged rather than copied.

phases.title: Verify the immigration rules, exchange rates and funding calculations
phases.note: UK Graduate visa length and Canadian post-study work permit eligibility
phases.judgment: It checked the post-study work rules instead of assuming them: the UK Graduate visa for this group is 18 months, not two years, and the Canadian work permit stays marked as conditional.

phases.title: Check desktop and phone layout and re-run the arithmetic independently
phases.note: Funding gaps shown with and without a USD 5,000 emergency reserve
phases.judgment: An independent re-run of the arithmetic reproduced all 40 derived figures with no errors, and the guide marks as unconfirmed anything the schools have not yet published for 2027.

workers: Checked fees, admission rules and 2027 deadlines for two one-year UK MBAs, plus scholarships open to Nigerians
Read the official admissions, cost and funding pages for two Canadian two-year MBAs and the study-permit and work-permit rules
Collected official tuition, admission and format details for two well-regarded online MBAs
